title: Sidney Bechet and the Victor Ballroom jams
summary: Vincent played mandolin with Bechet at the Victor Ballroom at Lafayette and Rampart, where musicians jammed upstairs.

Did you work with Bechet any? Bass? Sidney Bechet. Sidney, no, I was just, I was playing mandolin then. I played a couple of pieces with him, you know, with Tyence Williams, you know, in Peron. Remember Victor Ball? Yeah, yeah. Rampard and Hobbs Avenue. But you see, it's good, and work out with them sometimes, in Henle-Raw. I remember Victor Ball was a lovely Rampard. Yeah. Victor Ball?
